page.overview:
Who is Tina Belcher?

Tina Ruth Belcher is the oldest child of Bob and Linda Belcher and is the oldest sibling of Gene and Louise Belcher. She makes her first appearance in Season 25 episode "Homerland" during the closing credits.

During the closing credits in "Homerland," Tina and her family were in the Simpson House celebrating the 25th season.

When Marge pushed Homer through the door and ended up entering a different reality into the restaurant Bob's Burgers, Tina and her family were watching him. She said that Bob Number 2 was throwing out with some major 'tube.
